hook: OpenAI claims licensing copyrighted work at scale is impossible, but a new legal filing proves otherwise.

sections.voiceover: OpenAI claims licensing copyrighted work at scale is impossible, but a new legal filing proves otherwise.
Does the Human Consent Foundation challenge OpenAI's claim that licensing copyrighted work is impossible?
Cate Blanchett's Human Consent Foundation and a coalition filed this brief on Friday in New York.

This 31-page brief directly disputes OpenAI's claim that mass licensing remains technically impossible to achieve. Writer, Inc. and other groups joined this 31-page amicus brief to prove mass licensing is actually doable.
The 31-page document now awaits review by the court.
